findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/workflow-convergence-failure-remediation-execution-plan.md:114-123,545-564,615-646 — medium: the #7/B-8195 outcome and boundary are not actually recorded. The only new text places routine-validate writer closeout inside Workstream A even though 6.1 says that workstream owns C1 only; the landing-order table still lists only five stories and the exit criterion still says all five stories. Add a bounded implemented-contract/status entry (or an explicit interposed follow-up row) naming B-8195, its one-shot TEST-transition/CLI-terminal closeout result, verifier-entry fail-closed boundary, and non-goals, without implying C1/DONE-required scope absorbed routine validate.

packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1250-1258,1382: HIGH — the new canonical terminal closeout throws on transaction failure, but writeCodexProcessEvent catches that error and only reports a health issue; run() then continues to print the original successful validate/story_advance result and exits 0. A commit-hook/CAS/persistence failure can therefore publish a reused PASS while its terminal audit closeout failed, directly violating the story contract that persistence failure must never report PASS or require a blind retry. Make closeout failure part of the command result/exit path while avoiding recursive error-event writes, or perform the required terminal closeout inside a transaction whose failure the caller cannot swallow.
